title: CEOs of Anthropic and Google DeepMind call for U.S.-led AI coalition in meeting at G7 (Kai Nicol-Schwarz/CNBC)
summary: Kai Nicol-Schwarz / CNBC: CEOs of Anthropic and Google DeepMind call for U.S.-led AI coalition in meeting at G7 … Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis called for a U.S.-led coalition to shape rules and standards around artificial intelligence at a meeting with tech leaders and heads of state …
